translations.text: O bright Lord, Creator of the people!

Wretched is he who here on earth, by day and by night, fights for the devil and does his will; woe to him for that pleasure when he receives and beholds the reward for it, unless he first turns away from that evil.

Blessed is he who here on earth, by day and by night, obeys the Lord and always does his will; it will go well for him for that work when he receives and beholds the reward for it, if he comes to a wholly good end.
O Light of light! O joy of life!
Grant me, glorious King, when I pray for my soul, heaven's eternal grace. You are gracious, God; you alone hold and rule over all the earth and the heavens of the wide creation.
